label: r02-A-T3-7
critiques: The runTrial prompt does not mention grade.py, answers.json, judge.md, or the predictions. It never tells the trial agent not to read them, though. Its only restriction is "Do not create or edit any other file", which covers writing and not reading.
The answer defines `args.smoke: true`. That run uses "1 ticket, both configs, and 1 trial" and writes to spe/evals/runs/r04/smoke/. The gates paragraph launches it before the full run.

The answer includes a grader selftest: "build a fixture run from answers.json... expect 100 percent... flip two labels... expect exactly two misses." It has no regrade of round 3 results as a control. r03 is mentioned only as the source of the runner command.

The script sets CAP_USD = 40. It throws in Preflight if the projected cost is over the cap. Before each trial round it checks `spentUsd + nextTrialUsd + args.estAgentUsd > CAP_USD`, and if so it sets stoppedByCap and logs "Cap stop before trial ...". This enforces the cap before costly work and logs the stop.

grade.py checks category and priority against answers.json and is the label grader. The judge prompt says "Score tone only. A separate code grader checks the category and priority labels, so ignore them."
The script has no logic that adds trials to cells where only some trials passed. Every cell gets exactly `trials` runs, and no top-up cap is stated.
The script holds the round in `const ROUND = 'r04'`. Its Summary phase only computes means and rates in code. It has no failure-analysis step and no completeness-critic agent.
